name: Adityaya Somaya (the nine grahas)
text:
आदित्याय सोमाय मङ्गलाय बुधाय च ।
गुरुशुक्रशनिभ्यश्च राहवे केतवे नमः ॥
meaning: Salutations to Aditya (the Sun), Soma (the Moon), Mangala (Mars) and Budha (Mercury); to Guru (Jupiter), Shukra (Venus) and Shani (Saturn); and to Rahu and Ketu, the north and south nodes of the Moon.
note: The salutation to the nine grahas of Jyotisha, the planetary powers of Indian astrology. The words are separated as in the standard verse, at Sarvakali’s direction. A devotional salutation, not a forecast.
source: The navagraha salutation in common devotional use; wording as confirmed by Sarvakali
